notes: Kmart AU is a general mass-market retailer (per brief), scoped strictly to the Home & Living > Home Decor / Bathroom(Mirrors) / Dining(tableware+glassware+serveware) branches - did not enumerate Furniture, Bedding, Storage & Organisation, Cleaning, Appliances, Home Office & Stationery, Pets, Home & Car Maintenance or the rest of the site (same discipline as S.N. 22 Target Home / S.N. 47 Bed Bath & Beyond). ACCESS ROUTE: robots.txt (curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation) shows only generic Disallow rules (/api/, /login, /bag, /checkout etc, standard for all bots) - no Claude-specific disallow, site fully live, no closure notice (Rule 3 n/a). Direct/impersonated fetches of the homepage succeed, but every /category/ PLP URL is behind an Akamai Bot Manager behavioral (sec-cpt) JS challenge from this IP regardless of curl_cffi profile (10 profiles tried) or r.jina.ai (itself Cloudflare-challenged at time of run) - browser automation is disallowed on this project (shared pool browser). WORKAROUND: the homepage's Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ payload embeds the site's full live navigation taxonomy (props.navigationProps.staticHeaderData) with per-node product counts, and the page also exposes a public Constructor.io search API key (key_GZTqlLr41FS2p7AY) for ac.cnstrc.com - a third-party search backend NOT behind Kmart's Akamai. Every qty in this file was pulled from Constructor.io's /browse/group_id/<id> endpoint's total_num_results (equivalent to Target's redsky total_results) and VERIFIED per Rule 1 by requesting the last page (per num_results_per_page=24) and the page beyond it for every included leaf: in all 25 distinct leaves checked, the last page returned exactly the expected remainder and the following page returned zero results, confirming totals are exact (not Shopify-style inflated). MARKETPLACE NOISE (flagged for this company in the brief): Kmart's Home Decor categories are heavily mixed with third-party marketplace sellers via a "Shops" facet (e.g. Clocks 380 total includes only ~4 tagged seller "Kmart"; Wall Art 410 only ~16; Mirrors 201 only ~34; Vases 202 only ~35) - the majority of inventory shown under these URLs on kmart.com.au is drop-shipped marketplace stock (sellers incl. Advwin, Ausway, Costway, VidaXL, Aisle Six, Kamprad's Oikos 1943, and even one seller literally named "Target"), not Kmart's own range. Per THE ONE RULE qty reflects the exact number the site itself displays under that category (verified exact, not inflated) so marketplace items were kept, not purged - this composition is noted for reviewer awareness rather than flagged row-by-row, since the numbers themselves are confirmed accurate. DUPLICATE MENU-PLACEMENT QUIRK: Kmart's own nav has the same canonical URL reachable from multiple parent menus with different internal Constructor.io group_ids and sometimes different counts for the SAME url (e.g. /category/home-and-living/lighting/ = 980 in the Home Decor menu context vs 504 in the Rugs & Home Furnishings menu context; /category/home-and-living/mirrors/ appears under both Home Decor and Bathroom with a consistent 201; /category/home-and-living/curtains-and-rods/ shows 369/104/43 across three placements). Per Rule 0.6 (same URL = same listing) every such node was counted ONCE using its most natural/primary taxonomy placement, cross-verified via boundary pagination; the Bedroom department's "Bedroom Decor" node was confirmed to be a pure re-link of the same Decor Accessories / Candles & Home Fragrance / Frames & Albums URLs already captured under Home Decor - no new items. EXCLUSIONS (title-verified where ambiguous): all of Candles & Home Fragrance incl. "100% Soy Candles" (titles are explicitly fragranced, e.g. 'XL Amber Tonka Soy Wax Ceramic Candle') and Diffusers/Essential Oils/Wax Warmers/Wax Melts (home fragrance); Artificial Plants & Flowers; Rugs and all Cushions/Cushion Covers (textiles); Curtains (Blockout/Sheer, textiles) and the duplicate 'Curtains & Rods' node under DIY (curtains-and-rods21032023024612, sampled titles are almost all fabric curtains); Globes & Light Bulbs + Halogen Globes + Filament Bulbs (bulbs, Rule 0.2); Smart Lighting (52 items - mixed roll-up, sampled titles show literal Wi-Fi LED 'Bulb' products interleaved with fixtures, dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop don't pad', unlike LED Lights & Neon Lights (224) whose 15-item title sample was 100% fixtures/novelty lighting - kept, matches Target's Novelty Lighting precedent); Baskets (storage, titles confirm plain/woven storage baskets and tubs); DIY node incl. Adhesive Film & Wallpaper, Floor & Wall Tiles, Hooks & Hanger Solutions (titles = Command strips / over-the-door hooks, generic hardware not decorative), Shop All DIY; the separate 'Hooks' node under Home & Car Maintenance (Picture Hooks/Removable Hooks, titles = picture-hanging hardware, out of the Home & Living department entirely); Wall Hooks & Coat Racks (2 items, titles are freestanding coat stands = furniture); Door Mats; Bathroom Storage/Bathroom Accessories/Towels/Bath Mats/Shower Curtains (Bathroom Accessories sampled - dominated by soap dispensers, toilet brushes, bins, toilet-roll-holders = functional plumbing/fixture accessories, not genuinely decorative per brief's carve-out); Toilet Accessories, Bathroom Scales; Kitchen department in full (appliances/cookware/cutlery/storage, all excluded categories); Cutlery, Travel Cups; Jugs & Glass Bottles (283, appears under both Dinnerware and Serveware with identical count/URL - mixed roll-up of decorative glass jugs AND functional BPA-free plastic fridge jugs/branded drink bottles, titles confirmed, dropped); Outdoor Drinkware (22 - mixed roll-up of acrylic glassware and branded AFL-team sports drink bottles, titles confirmed, dropped; Outdoor Dinnerware kept, titles are clean plate/bowl sets); Tableware node (Placemats/Napkins/Tablecloths/Table Runners, all textile); Kitchen Linen & Tea Towels; Albums (9, photo/scrapbook storage albums, not picture frames - kept only Decor/Classic/Gallery Frames from the Frames & Albums node); price-facet nodes (Home Decor $15 & Under, Dining $25 & Under) and Shop All/Latest Arrivals/Clearance/Shop by Collection nodes, never extracted per brief. RULE 0: Kids Lighting and Desk Lighting kept as room/function-scoped lighting leaves (0.1/0.2); Bathroom Mirrors (10) was NOT added as a separate row from Mirrors (201) - unlike Target's structure where Bathroom Mirrors was a sibling leaf, Kmart nests Bathroom Mirrors as a child of the single Mirrors node (same URL, same 201 total in both the Home Decor and Bathroom menu placements), so it reads as a facet subset of the one Mirrors listing rather than an independent branch - judgment call, documented here. 'Frames & Albums' parent (307 total) could not be exactly resolved into an 'all frames' number - the 3 named subtypes (Decor/Classic/Gallery = 121) plus Albums (9) leave ~177 further frame items (poster frames, certificate frames, frame boxes, magnetic frames per title sample) with no site-reported exact count isolating them from Albums, so per 'mixed roll-ups: drop don't pad' only the 3 clean named subtypes were kept as leaves under a Picture Frames parent row.
